content.text: While Ilicali maintains his confidence in winning an appeal against the sanction, there is no doubt that this is a concerning time for fans.
Many fans continue to strongly support Acun Ilicali. The club offers some of the most affordable tickets in the EFL, and additionally, there is complimentary travel for away games.

Acun Ilicali: With regards to payments to suppliers, unfortunately, the club experienced a cash flow issue when it didn't receive a £1.5m payment for a player which was intended to clear invoices from suppliers.
